# 上清大洞真經玉訣音義--陳景元

**ID:** KR5a0105
**Custom ID:** ZB5a0105

## Authors / Editors
- 陳景元 1025 - 1094

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A sixteen-folio collection of philological notes on the *Dàdòng zhēnjīng* 大洞真經 and related Shàngqīng texts by Chén Jǐngyuán 陳景元 (1025–1094). The author uses and compares a number of different versions of the *Dàdòng zhēnjīng*, the most important of which are the recensions by Zhū Zìyīng 朱自英 (*[DZ 6 Shàngqīng dàdòng zhēnjīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0006)*) and by Huángfǔ Xī 皇甫希, both of the period 1023–1031. For variant readings Chén also consulted the now-lost *Yīqiè dàojīng yīnyì* 一切道經音義 by Shī Chōng 史崇 (see *[DZ 1123 Yīqiē dàojīng yīnyì miàomén yóuqǐ](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a1123)*) and an unknown old manuscript (*gǔběn* 古本).

The work also treats a series of related Shàngqīng texts:

- The *nèizhù yǐnwén* 內主隱文 ("Hidden Texts of the Inner Invocations") from the *Miémó shénhuì yùjīng yǐnshū* (*[DZ 1355 Shàngqīng tàishàng yùqīng yǐnshū miémó shénhuì gāoxuán zhēnjīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a1355)*).
- The *dàojūn yùzhù* 道君玉注 ("Precious Glosses of the Old Lord"), corresponding to the revealed commentary partially preserved in *YJQQ* 8.1a–18b.
- The *Huíyuán fǎ* 迴元法 ("Method of the Return to the Origin") as given in *[DZ 1377 Shàngqīng tàishàng jiǔzhēn zhōngjīng jiàngshēng shéndān jué](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a1377)* 4b–11a.
- The *zǐwén dānzhāng* 紫文丹章 ("Cinnabar Stanzas in Purple Writing") from *[DZ 1355 Gāoxuán zhēnjīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a1355)* 37b–42b.
- The *bǎishén shàngfǎ* 百神上法 ("Superior Method of the Hundred Gods") from the beginning of *[DZ 1360 Shàngqīng jiǔtiān shàngdì zhù bǎishén nèimíng jīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a1360)*, which gives the names of the heavens and earths placed at the end of each section of DZ 6.

**Abstract**

Isabelle Robinet, in Schipper & Verellen eds., *The Taoist Canon* (2004) 2:— (§3.B.4, Shàngqīng), identifies the work as Chén Jǐngyuán's definitive philological study of the *Dàdòng zhēnjīng* textual tradition. The commentary places the present [DZ 6](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0006) edition within Chén's "Zhū Zìyīng version" / *Sāndòng fǎshī Guānmiào xiānshēng běn* 三洞法師觀妙先生本 classification. The frontmatter brackets composition notBefore 1067 (Chén's *Sìzhù* preface) / notAfter 1094 (Chén's death), with dynasty 北宋. Chén Jǐngyuán is the sole catalog-meta person wikilinked.
